verdict: Accurate real-API usage: bl-switch with the real bl-switch-toggle CustomEvent<boolean>, and bl-select with real label/help-text/placeholder attributes plus real bl-select-option value attribute; language dropdown and on/off toggles with per-option hint text fully implement the brief with no hallucinated members. Minor nuance: the switch label text lives outside the bl-switch default slot as a sibling within a native <label>, which still associates and keeps the toggles clickable, so accessibility is only minimally short of ideal.
